reasons.localDishMaterialsProjection: NOT_APPLICABLE: weekly-dish-materials is a client projection of the catalog and selected dish, not an independently owned query region
reasons.refreshingWithoutReadTrigger: NEEDS_EVIDENCE: WeeklyMenuPage exposes no identity-local read-only refresh trigger after populated data
reasons.staleErrorWithoutReadTrigger: NEEDS_EVIDENCE: WeeklyMenuPage cannot safely create a failed refetch with retained data without cache manipulation
